Summary: AEO Appointments | Store Teams will need the ability to disable or adjust available hours for a specific future date
Description:
Current Scenario: Within the current Appointment Availability Flow, store teams are able to set a generic availability for their (Appointment) Operating hours. This availability (or operating hours) is a static value that repeats applies for all future dates, without the ability to set a start and end time for any date in particular. 

Issue Identified: As we approach holiday, we need to be able to block appointments from being scheduled on certain dates like Thanksgiving, Black Friday and Christmas. Functionality does not exist within the current product, to block of these dates. If we were to “turn off” time slots on a Thursday, it will turn off all time slots for any thursday from now and beyond the desired date. 

Future Scenario:  The ability for a store team to select a specific future date and set the operating hours, or customize a specific time block that the store can set appointment time slots.

04/Jan/24 10:13 AM;5c8fc286627d3b2d0163b7f7;[~accountid:qm:d8936ec3-5736-46a1-a0a2-e185d8b412c9:e7d02bf3-3738-4958-84f8-3771b9ccf00d] So two parts to this:

# Based on the description it sounds to me that for the spend $300 qualification, the qualifying items reward eligible flag is false (this can be seen under advanced fields on the offer step). Summary: Pricing API | Need the ability to get all pricing regardless of active simple scans
Description:
+*Ask*+:

We need to have the pricing api support us getting pricing for all the skus (including list and discounted prices) regardless of whether there are any active promotions running. So every time we call this api the output should contain the list of all the skus. 

/api/promotion/generatePriceList api. 



+*Business Requirements:*+

JDA will continue to host pricing for ALL skus and will continue to be pricing master.

Digital (Ecomm) needs the following pricing:

* Regular Prices (All skus)
* Discounted Prices: (Skus which are running simple scans)

Instead of TVS going to Jumpmind for Discounted prices and JDA for regular and then combining it , we would like to have all pricing related information flow in from JMC (including simple scans)

+*_Acceptance Criteria_*+

* API from JMC Unified Commerce which sends the list of all SKUs (and its pricing) regardless of whether there are activate promotions or not.
* If active promotion is present it will factor that in and send the simple scan prices along with other Data including regular prices.

Summary: Exchange Refund is giving Tender Not Permitted message trying to refund to the originally paid CC (Adyen)
Description:
RCL Ticket Reference - [https://logicinfo.atlassian.net/browse/RCL-1214|https://logicinfo.atlassian.net/browse/RCL-1214|smart-link] 

Steps to recreate

# Complete a sale with a single item, pay with a credit card (Adyen).
# Scan receipt from step 1 and do an even exchange for that item for a different size. Sale Balance Due should be 0.

Summary: Timezone Issue: Promotions created with inaccurate start/end times in Database
Description:
Please refer to the attached screenshot. We created a promotion TECHANDA-408 at 12:20 PM EST using JMC Central tool , the effective start and end date on this promotion was set to 1/2 12:30 PM to 1/3 12:30 PM using Centrail Tool . 

The user that created the promotion was based in Eastern time zone. 

In the database table however we noticed that while the creation date and time is properly saved as server time (UTC). Start and End time are not getting saved in UTC but the timezone of the user that is using central tool. This should also eventually be saved as UTC to the database.
Comments:
18/Jan/24 1:10 PM;5c8fc1cd627d3b2d0163b7f1;[~accountid:qm:d8936ec3-5736-46a1-a0a2-e185d8b412c9:c6a093bd-15b6-4fdb-bc28-40e8c802375c] The db date/times are correct.  These have to be in local time when you want the promotion to be in effect.  I.e. the promotion should run from 12:30pm - 5:30pm for all stores which means if you store this in UTC (12:30pm EST) then the promotion would be occurring at store in California from 9:30am - 2:30pm.

Create time is the true time the record was created and is store in UTC.

Summary: Duplicate Transactions Created Due to Sequence Number Sync Issue
Description:
TVS reported an issue where EJ was showing some funky data for a transaction.  I believe it happened due to the issue reported in [https://jumpmind.atlassian.net/browse/JMCH-318|https://jumpmind.atlassian.net/browse/JMCH-318|smart-link] which I believe there is a fix for.  From this morning’s touchpoint, Scott still asked to create a ticket for JM visibility.  Can we share access to TVS as well.



*What happened:*

The iPad (0593-021) failovered to the cloud and transaction #925 was started for the first time.

The iPad (0593-021) then reconnected to the ISP an a new transaction was started using #925.  This transaction was suspended on the 0593-021 and then resumed on the fixed station (0593-001).



When we look at the EJ entry for the transaction, we see evidence that 2 transactions were combined.

# The transaction has a status of “Suspended Retrieved” which means that tenders should not exist for the transaction.  But the EJ shows that the transaction contains tender line items.  These tender line items are the tenders from the first #925 transaction that was created while the device was failing over to the cloud.
#  when we see that the retail line items all exist amongst the 2 transaction objects.
## First #925 instance (created with failover)
### {{2175495}}
### {{1618586}}
### {{2230886}}
## Second #925 instance (created with ISP)
### {{2243848}}
# When we run the same queries against the line item tables, we see different results amongst the cloud db and the in store db.  The in store DB only has data a from the 2nd #925 transaction.  The cloud DB has data from both.



I’ll also attach an export of the issue on the TVS board.

Summary: TPS Lab Bug - Editing Delivery Address Issue
Description:
When an address is entered for a delivery or ship to home order, there is no way to go ‘back’ and change the address if a mistake is made or address needs to be changed. Please see the steps below: 

# Login and begin a transaction
# Add a single item to a delivery order. 
# Enter a customer as a guest and enter a fake address, making an error in the address. 
# Choose ‘complete' to get kicked back to to transaction screen.

Is this base functionality? We should have the ability to “edit” post the initial entry in case a mistake or change needs to be made once back at the transaction screen.

Summary: Business date reflected incorrect day
Description:
RCL had 2 issues in their production store.

# On 9/19 business date = 20230919 in the middle of the day out of the blue a transaction was recorded with 20230918.  See below snippet showing the before and after transactions all having correct business date.

!image-20240923-163313.png|width=1236,height=457,alt="image-20240923-163313.png"!

# Morning of 9/23, RCL opened their store as normal from device 01.  They proceeded to open device and till for 2 devices.  After this it was noticed on device 01 a toast message saying the business date doesn’t match the current date so they proceeded to close the tills, device and store.
In the database ops_unit_status reflected this exactly, after devices were opened there were lines that recorded the close and reconcile but with the 20230919 date (on 9/23).  They have successfully opened and closed each day since go live with no issue.
The below snippet shows the close record captured at 8am for the wrong business date.

!image-20240923-164710.png|width=1277,height=468,alt="image-20240923-164710.png"!

To get around the issue and allow them to open, we removed the invalid close records from the ops_unit_status table and all started working at the store again.

Summary: TPS Delivery Order Bug - Removed Item Still Shows in Shipping Screen
Description:
If an item is removed from a delivery order, but other items remain on the delivery order, the removed item still appears in the shipping screen and charges the customer. There is no way to remove the item in the shipping screen. The entire transaction has to be canceled and redone. Please see the steps below on how to recreate: 

# Login and begin a transaction.
# Add an item to a delivery order (I used item #24669800005)
# Add a customer or guest to the delivery order - doesn’t matter either one.
# When back @ transaction screen, remove the item that was just added. 
# Add another item to the transaction (I added #24669800005 again). 
# Note that the total in the transaction screen is correct and doesn’t have the removed item. Hit “checkout”. 
# When you move to the shipping screen, both items will appear even though one was removed, the total jumps up and there is no way to go back and remove the second item since its already removed from the transaction.

Summary: Was customer validation for customer edit removed in version 243?
Description:
TVS has reported that when an associate updates a customer’s name, address, or phone number, there is no longer a prompt on the customer display for validation of these details.

Upon reviewing the EditCustomerFlow, I noticed some changes between versions 241.0 and 243.3.

*Version 241.0:*

{noformat}EditCustomerFlow:
  - EditCustomerState:
      Back: CompleteState
      ValidateCustomer: ValidateCustomerState
      ValidateEmailAddress: ValidateCustomerEmailState
      ValidateCustomerAddress: ValidateCustomerAddressState
      CustomerEdited: CompleteState
  - ValidateCustomerState:
      Back: EditCustomerState
      Exit: CompleteState
      ContinueEditCustomer: EditCustomerState
      ValidateEmailAddress: ValidateCustomerEmailState
      ValidateCustomerAddress: ValidateCustomerAddressState
      CustomerEdited: CompleteState
  - ValidateCustomerEmailState:
      Back: EditCustomerState
      Edit: EditCustomerState
      ContinueEditCustomer: EditCustomerState
  - ValidateCustomerAddressState:
      Back: EditCustomerState
      Exit: CompleteState
      MakeCorrections: EditCustomerState
      ContinueEditCustomer: EditCustomerState
      CustomerEdited: CompleteState{noformat}

*Version 243.3:*

{noformat}EditCustomerFlow:
  - EditCustomerInitState:
      Continue: EditCustomerState
  - EditCustomerState:
      Back: CompleteState
      CustomerEdited: CompleteState{noformat}



It appears that the validation flow has been refactored. Additionally, I found related details in the {{customerdisplay-flow.yml}}:

{noformat}CustomerDisplayCustomerConfirmationFlow:
  - CXCustomerRouterState:
      ConfirmCustomerAddress: ConfirmCustomerAddressState
      ConfirmCustomerEmail: ConfirmCustomerEmailState
      ConfirmTermsAndConditions: ConfirmTermsAndConditionsState
      ConfirmGlobalPrivacyPolicy: ConfirmGlobalPrivacyPolicyState
      ConfirmCustomerContactPreferences: ConfirmCustomerContactPreferencesState
  - ConfirmCustomerAddressState:
      CancelledByCashier: CompleteState
      Accept: CompleteState
      Reject: CompleteState
  - ConfirmCustomerEmailState:
      CancelledByCashier: CompleteState
      Accept: CompleteState
      Reject: CompleteState
  - ConfirmTermsAndConditionsState:
      CancelledByCashier: CompleteState
      Accept: CompleteState
      Reject: CompleteState
  - ConfirmGlobalPrivacyPolicyState:
      CancelledByCashier: CompleteState
      Accept: CompleteState
      Reject: CompleteState
  - ConfirmCustomerContactPreferencesState:
      CancelledByCashier: CompleteState
#      Accept: Handled by action handler
      Reject: CompleteState
      Next: CompleteState
      ViewTermsAndConditions: ConfirmCustomerContactPreferencesState{noformat}



Based on these observations, is it correct to assume that it is expected behavior for the Edit Customer flow to *not* include customer validation in version 243?  And if true, is JumpMind going to plan on adding it back in?

"1" + modifiedDeviceId + sequenceNumber
where modifiedDeviceId = device_id with dash removed (e.g., 05243-001 = 05243001)
sequenceNumber = CUSTOMER sequence number value from ctx_sequence , left padded with zeros to a length of 7 
It looks like either the endpoint was overridden in your code or possibly the device id you have in your system might be 0008-customerdisplay?

Could you take a look at the dev_device table and provide what you see there:
select * from dev_device where device_id like '0008%';

ParentOrderId is used for customers that could have multiple shipments of items being sent to a customer within a single transaction.   For example, if a basket contains items that are refrigerated, and items that do not require refrigeration, it could result in two separate shipments of items (a.k.a separate "Delivery Groups") to the customer (as determined by the {{getOrderDeliveryGroups}} endpoint).  In commerce, this would actually be considered two orders, each with their own order ID, but tied together by the common Parent Order Id.  Commerce will automatically generate a ParentOrderId for an order using the {{getParentOrderId}} endpoint.  The base implementation will produce a value in the format {{businessUnitId+businessDate+transactionSequenceNumber}} .  The retailer may override this endpoint if necessary to use other means to create a parentOrderId, such as making a call to their OMS system.



Let me know if you think that needs any further explanation

Summary: Issue with hasVouchers$ Evaluation Timing in CustomerDetailsScreenComponent
Description:
TVS reported an issue where the customer details screen was displaying {{linked.customer.details.noVouchersFound.label}} even though there were vouchers for that customer being displayed.



*Description:* In the {{CustomerDetailsScreenComponent}}, the {{buildScreen}} method evaluates the {{hasVouchers$}} property before the asynchronous data retrieval for vouchers completes. This results in {{hasVouchers$}} being set to {{false}}, even when there are available vouchers.

*Expected Behavior:* {{hasVouchers$}} should accurately reflect whether there are available or redeemed/expired vouchers based on the data retrieved from the service.

*Actual Behavior:* {{hasVouchers$}} is often {{false}} due to being evaluated before the data has been set.

*Proposed Solution:* Move the evaluation of {{hasVouchers$}} inside the subscription callback for the vouchers data retrieval, ensuring it is set only after the voucher data has been processed.

*Pertinent Code:*

{noformat}this.dataMessageService.getData$(this.screen.vouchersDataKey).subscribe(vouchers => { this.delegateVoucherData(vouchers); 
...
this.hasVouchers$ = this.availableVouchersData$?.length > 0 || this.redeemedOrExpiredVouchersData$?.length > 0; });{noformat}

I believe what is happening is that {{hasVouchers$}} is getting initialized before {{availableVouchersData$}} or {{redeemedOrExpiredVoucherData$}} is populated.  Thus why we are seeing a list of vouchers but also the missing vouchers text.

Summary: Manual Coupons: When multiple coupons applied (%/$) they should be applied % first then $ to give customer the best deal.
Description:
RCL Ticket Reference -

[https://logicinfo.atlassian.net/browse/RCL-1287|https://logicinfo.atlassian.net/browse/RCL-1287|smart-link] 

RCL Refers to manual coupons as “Group Discounts” 

POS: Group Discount: When multiple group discs applied (%/$) they should be applied % first then $ to give customer the best deal.

EX. TXN 4524

Item 2 has both the Group Discount 1 (25%) and Group Discount 2 ($10)

the item is 149.95 it seems group discount 2 ($10) was applied first but if Group Discount 1 ( % ) had been applied first 24% of 149.95 is 37.48 not 35.52.

What it should be:

36116127 14.97 less group 1 25% off (3.74) = 11.23

3686309 149.95 less group 1 25% off (37.48) = 112.47 part of group discount 2 (before 112.47) 7.39 = 106.08

36723415 less promo (4.99) = 19.58

36779303 part of group discount 2 (before 14.97) .98= 13.99

36500487 part of group discount 2 (before 24.97) 1.63 = 23.34

Group 2 112.47 + 14.97 + 24.97 = 152.41

112.47 is 73.7% of the group, 14.97 is 9.8 % of the group, 24.97 is 16.3% of the group (so percents of the $10)

So that is sub-total before tax of 174.22 which is less that the 175.58 charged the customer.

Summary: Disaster recovery situations - Sales Recovery and keeping up with next transaction numbers for Fixed/ISP post DR
Description:
With TVS implementation of commerce where can be n number of DR sceanarios needing sales recovery and setting up Next Transaction Number post DR. Few critical scenarios listed below to discuss how we could solve for sales recovery and next tran number

+Scenario 1+

Fixed station register at the store requires to be replaced but All sales up-to-date in the cloud home office database for both fixed and mobile POS

* Next transaction number - Sales Audit holds this and expects sequence to be maintained
** How do we get the next transaction number synced up to where we left off before DR for Fixed station
** How do we get the next transaction number synced up to where we left off before DR for MPOS
* Sales recovery - populating local SLS tables
** How to get the SLS tables synced between cloud and new register local DB post DR

+Scenario 2+

Fixed station register at the store requires to be replaced and that register had been offline to the cloud for say day or 2 with transactions done and held just within the local store DB

* Sales recovery - populating cloud SLS tables
** How to get the SLS tables synced between cloud and new register local DB post DR
* Next transaction number - Sales Audit holds this and expects sequence to be maintained
** How do we get the next transaction number synced up to where we left off before DR for Fixed station
** How do we get the next transaction number synced up to where we left off before DR for MPOS
** Note: In this scenario local DB holds the key to this and Sales Audit as register is offline to cloud central DB

+Scenario 3+

Fixed station register at the store requires to be replaced and that register had been offline to the cloud for say day or 2 with transactions done and held just within the local store DB. Additionally the Mobile devices failed over to the cloud and are adding transactions to the cloud DB

* Sales recovery - populating cloud SLS tables with what is not there and populating local SLS tables with what is not there
** How to get the SLS tables synced between cloud and new register local DB post DR
* Next transaction number - Sales Audit holds this and expects sequence to be maintained
** How do we get the next transaction number synced up to where we left off before DR for Fixed station
** How do we get the next transaction number synced up to where we left off before DR for MPOS
** Note: In this scenario the reconciliation between cloud and local holds the key to this and Sales Audit as register is offline to cloud central DB



we can start with these 3 and identify a pathway for the 2 topics

23/Oct/24 11:30 AM;712020:e559f345-10b2-4354-82f0-bb2ee2eb0d83;Update on caching from Chris

Item data is cached based on the provided effective datetime. If the effective datetime is left blank, the current datetime is used. In either case, the datetime is normalized to the nearest hour, and that value is used as the cache key. If the effective times of an item are changed, and you pass in the same effective datetime, you may retrieve a previously cached version of the item (since the cache never expires).
In a clustered environment with multiple pods, different versions of the item may be cached across pods, depending on when the cache was populated on each pod.



For example, if you pass in an effective datetime of {{2024-10-23 05:00:00}} and the item's end time is set to {{2024-10-23 03:00:00}}, the cache will contain a not-yet-active version of the item. If the end time is later updated to {{2024-10-23 12:00:00}} and you continue to pass in {{2024-10-23 05:00:00}} as the effective datetime, you would still retrieve the not-yet-active version of the item (provided you hit the same server). However, if your request is routed to a server that hasn’t cached the item, you may get the updated active version instead. Subsequent requests across different pods would then result in inconsistent, unpredictable responses, as each pod could have different cached versions of the item.

Summary: SQL scripts in new module do not get ran when running centrally
Description:
TVS has a custom tender called Merch Credit.  Before 243, we were leveraging the flow for MANUAL_ENTRY to fulfill requirements.  However, since 243 introduce a new way to create custom tenders, we refactored the code so that Merch Credits used a custom tender type, freeing up MANUAL_ENTRY.



When doing this refactor, I tried to mimic the format in base.  This led us to create a new module called {{tvs-tenders}} that contain the following submodules

* {{tvs-tenders-flow}} 
* {{tvs-tenders-data}}
**  contains {{resources/data/tvs/foundation}}
*** post_02_ctx-button.sql
*** post_02_sls-tender.sql
*** post_02_sls-tender-policy.sql
* {{tvs-tenders-service}}
* {{tvs-tenders-service-api}}



To ensure that Spring recognizes the contents of these modules, we have the following added to {{tvs-base/build.gradle}}

{noformat}if (customerTendersEnabled.toBoolean()) {
    implementation project(":tvs-tenders:tvs-tenders-data")
    implementation project(":tvs-tenders:tvs-tenders-flow")
    api project(":tvs-tenders:tvs-tenders-service")
    api project(":tvs-tenders:tvs-tenders-service-api")
}{noformat}

Summary: When partially returning items from multiple sale transactions the tender card selection allows to over tender to incorrect card
Description:
If there are multiple original sale transactions with multiple items and you return a single item (or less than full sale) from both transactions, the tender card selection screen lets you continue to select the same card to return to even though the amount remaining is supposed to go to a different card.

----

Transaction with single item returned (has 2 items originally):

!image-20241024-194945.png|width=50%,alt="image-20241024-194945.png"!

2nd Transaction return all items:

!image-20241024-195014.png|width=50%,alt="image-20241024-195014.png"!

Tenders show:

!image-20241024-194612.png|width=50%,alt="image-20241024-194612.png"!

select the second one to return the 17.25 following screen shows remaining to return:

!image-20241024-195040.png|width=50%,alt="image-20241024-195040.png"!

Next click card again, below still shows the 17.25 card even though that was the total amount of the single item returned.

!image-20241024-195049.png|width=50%,alt="image-20241024-195049.png"!

This still lets you keep selecting the second card even though the other item(s) returned are not from that transaction. The expected would be the second card should not appear after the amount was accounted for. This works if you do a full return of all items on the trans and select that one first. The full amount is returned and then when you select card again it doesn’t even prompt because the remaining goes to the other card. You can see this with a 3 sale transaction example. If one is full return and selected first that one is removed from the list and only the other two remain.

Summary: SCPOS-476: RX EA - Display RX disclaimer on PDP
Description:
As part of the RX EA project at Petco, one of the business requirement is to display additional information is required to complete the sale of RX/Vet Diet items via EA.

Since we need to display this information, we need to Override some commerce code to display some new [productIdentifiers.In|http://productIdentifiers.In] order to achieve this, we need to override getProductIdentifiers method from ProductDetailsState class. Currently this method is private so we are not able to override it in the PetcoProductDetailsState class.

Creating this support ticket for JM support to change the method from private to protected.

Petco Jira ticket - [https://petcoalm.atlassian.net/browse/SCPOS-476|https://petcoalm.atlassian.net/browse/SCPOS-476|smart-link] 

----

Here are the additional details on this request/use case -

As part of EA/RD - Rx project on Petco side, one of the requirement from business team is to display a product disclaimer on the Product Details page under Item Search based on if the item is Rx medication or RX food. See attached sample screenshots SCPOS-476_RX_PDP.png & SCPOS-476_Vet_Diet_PDP.png for reference. In order to display the product disclaimer along with that Rx icon as per business requirement it will need client/angular code change but in order to avoid making angular code change (because current Commerce POS version 3.8 that Petco is using doesn't support overriding the client/angular code as per retailer needs), Petco Dev team recommended to show that disclaimer as per the attached screenshot SCPOS-476_RX_PDP_Dev_proposed.png and that can be achieved by making a server side code change by adding another Product Identifier on the server side by overriding some code in org.jumpmind.pos.app.state.iteminquiry.ProductDetailsState class. In this class, getProductIdentifiers method adds the list of identifiers to pass to client to show on the Product Details page.

We would like to override this method in the Petco code and add a new product identifier with disclaimer message that we can show on the UI but since this is a private method, we are not able to add another product identifier. Our request is to make this method and other private method buildPosItemIdsDisplayProperty being used within this method as protected so that we could override it as per Petco's business requirement.

Update… 
We only need getProductIdentifiers method to be changed from private to protected, not the other method buildPosItemIdsDisplayProperty that I mentioned in my comment.

Details of the change here:

h3. Order Fulfillment Revamp | Provide the ability to cancel a BOPIS, CURB or BISPIS Order after the order has been picked

h3. Narrative

As part of [https://jumpmind.atlassian.net/browse/JMC-3787|https://jumpmind.atlassian.net/browse/JMC-3787|smart-link], we introduced a way to cancel individual item(s) from an order as it was being picked. However, once an order is picked, there is no system way of canceling the order. In reality, especially when dealing with Store Pickup orders (BOPIS, CURB and BOSPIS), the customer may simply not come to pickup up their order. This change will introduce a systemic option for canceling an order, that in turn, can be fed to OMS systems.

h3. Changes

# Create a new *Cancel Order* button that is displayed when the order is in a PACK or DELIVER state
## Button will need access role defined as MANAGER
# Create a new dialog to display the reasons for canceling the order
# Create a client configurable list of Order Cancel Reason Codes
## Initial list will be:
### Customer Changed Mind
### Damaged
### Defective
### Oversold
### Wrong Item
# Create messaging to inform OMS systems the order was canceled and the reason

Summary: SCPOS-3555: Product Images not showing the default image in Item Inquiry
Description:
Ask is to provide a way to identify a default ‘product’ image to show that image first at the product level.

----

When we search through item inquiry with a word related for the products what we want to search, the images results was selected randomly to show into every products founded instead of take of the default image.

Example SKUs on prod that find by this string: prescription cat food.
002684178
003492098

We found that the query to get from database the imgs was taken for this query on itm-query.yml that use on ItemRepository.java for this function productImageQuery and ProductDetailsEndpoint.java call in this function populateImages:

QUERY:
  name: itemImagesByProductId
  where:
    product_id = ${productId}
    AND enabled = ${enabled}
  orderBy: line_sequence_number desc

ItemService.java this function calls all above to be called by getProductDetails method. so we need to improve this query to get all images with the default value that the table contains and always will show up the done url that its the first one for every SKU or product.

piece of needed query:
AND default_image = ${defaultImage}

piece of needed query on ItemRepository:
params.put("defaultImage", true);

----

Currently products don't have any default image, only the items linked to that product have default image. Ask is that when an image is displayed for a product on product list screen, Commerce application use any of the default image of the items linked to that product. Like you mentioned, this is probably an enhancement to the Commerce application.

Below SQL in itm-query.yml is what Commerce application runs when pulling the images for a product. We tested by adding another WHERE clause to this sql to pull only the default images using the default_image column and application displays one of the default image as expected.

QUERY:
  name: itemImagesByProductId
  where:
    product_id = ${productId}
    AND enabled = ${enabled}
  orderBy: line_sequence_number desc

Could you please check with Commerce team if this enhancement request can be incorporated in the current 3.8 version that Petco is using.

Summary: Question Regarding Token Usage from Pre-Authorization for Normal Authorization
Description:
We are configuring our application to process transactions in the following order for tender groups:

# *Order Items (PRE_AUTH)*
# *Normal Sale Items (AUTH)*
# *Repeat Delivery Items (PRE_AUTH)*

TVS wants to ensure that customers only need to swipe their card once. After the initial swipe (during the "Order Items" PRE_AUTH), the associate should be able to select the same card for another tender group and either authorize or pre-authorize it using the token created during the initial swipe.

However, when attempting to use the token from the initial pre-authorization (PRE_AUTH) during the normal authorization (AUTH) phase, we receive a {{30080}} response, indicating a "Token Mismatched" error.

It appears that tokens created from an authorization (AUTH) can successfully be used for a pre-authorization (PRE_AUTH), but the reverse is not working as expected.

*Question:*

# Can tokens generated from a Pre-Authorization (PRE_AUTH) be used for a subsequent Normal Authorization (AUTH)?
Comments: 06/Nov/24 3:48 PM;712020:e559f345-10b2-4354-82f0-bb2ee2eb0d83;Posted the question on internal slack channel.

07/Nov/24 7:15 AM;712020:e559f345-10b2-4354-82f0-bb2ee2eb0d83;We added special logic in our Aurus api while working on TVS to support re-use of the token which was collected for the Normal Sale items, to be used again for the pre-auth of the RD items.  We did not add any logic to allow re-use of the token from a pre-auth to the auth.



The root of the problem is that Aurus does not support re-using a token collected from one authorization (a "transaction" in their terminology) to another authorization.  Aurus would  likely allow re-use of the token if commerce were to leave the aurus "transaction" open throughout the entire tendering process, but commerce treats each tender as a separate, independent authorization ("transaction" in aurus terminology).  



When we tender for the Order items, we start an authorization with Aurus, and complete it.  Then when we tender the sale items we start another authorization with Aurus and complete it.  And finally when we tender for the RD items, we start another authorization with Aurus and complete it.



For token re-use, Aurus expects this pattern:

* Start the aurus authorization process.
* Tender the order items.
* Tender the Sale items
* Tender the RD items.
* Complete the aurus transaction.



To work around this difference in design between commerce and Aurus, there was a modification made that added logic to bypass the call to Aurus for pre-authorization of the RD items if we had already done an authorization for the store items.  If, while tendering the RD items, the cashier chooses to re-use the card that was used for tendering the store items, Aurus is not called at all, and I simply return the previous card information to commerce as if the pre-authorization had occurred with Aurus.

Summary: Special order - Incorrect Change Due Calculation and Multiple Change Flow Triggered During Cash Tendering
Description:
*Priority*: Blocker
*Version*: {{243.4.1}}

h3. *Description:*

When completing a sale and tendering with the {{IN_STORE}} group using cash for an amount greater than the sale balance, the application displays an incorrect change due amount and goes through the change due flow twice. This results in the cash drawer popping open two times, as observed both in the UI and in the logs.

h3. *Pre-Requisite:*

The configuration for tender groups has been updated to ensure that {{IN_STORE}} goes first in the order:

{noformat}openpos:
  tenders:
    tenderGroups:
      groups:
        IN_STORE:
          order: 1{noformat}

h3. *Steps to Reproduce:*

# *Start a Sale*: Open a new sale and attach a customer.
# *Scan IN_STORE Item*: Scan the item with SKU {{605631000050}} (IN_STORE).
# *Add DELIVERY Item*: Add the item with SKU {{516670AL85}} (DELIVERY).
# *Proceed to Payment*: Click on "Pay" and continue until the first tender options screen for the tender groups.
# *Tender IN_STORE*: Choose the {{IN_STORE}} option and tender the sale with cash.
# *Tender Greater than Balance*: Tender an amount greater than the sale balance due (e.g., more than the total sale amount).
# *Observe Behavior*: The application should display the correct change due and proceed with the change due flow.

h3. *Expected Result:*

* The correct change due amount should be calculated.
* The change due flow should only trigger once.
* The cash drawer should only open once.

h3. *Actual Result:*

* The application displays an incorrect change due amount.
* The change due flow triggers twice.
* The cash drawer opens twice, which is also logged in the application logs and visible in the UI toasts.

Summary: Single Use Coupons Cause No Rewards Number Loading
Description:
*  Environment (QA / Prod)? 

# All

* Build Version 

# Current (1.4.232.0.8.20241024.1)

* Details

We recently launched our first Single Use Coupon Campaign (Promote #09272024-32). The coupon is live in a single location and excluded from all other locations. Since the campaign went live, we are experiencing: 

# If a customer account is retrieved from the database without a Hallmark Rewards  Number (loyalty_number value is blank or NULL), when the check out button is hit, the register is stuck in a "loading" sequence. This happens if the coupon IS or ISNT present on the transaction. The register is then stuck for anywhere from 1-10+ minutes, often times needing a reset in order to operate normally again.
# Registers are working fine when this campaign is active in all other scenarios (i.e no customer account attached or customer account attached with a Hallmark Number (loyalty_account). 
# The campaign within promote is is no way tied to needing a loyalty_account present.

* Steps to recreate the issue
* 1. Login to a transaction and create mock sale
* 2. Retrieve a customer that has no Loyalty Number (Hallmark Number) associated. Hit Check out. 
* 3. If any single use coupon campaign is active, this will cause the application to get stuck loading.

Description:
Not sure if this is a feature but wanted to express what we are looking for:

There are times where our store staff need to leave a dynamic comment on an item,  either related to a static discount reason or just a comment on the item in general, to which the comment is added to the database and reviewed by our LP team if needed. We had an issue over the weekend where GC Tender Bypass screen request timeout caused a Sync issue and a huge 3+ minute delay. We have heard about this from stores and tickets earlier but now with this situation we have logs and some initial analysis on what is causing to escalate to you.

Summary: Promote - Version 243.2 Search observations

Summary: Deserialization Issue Due to Date/LocalDateTime Mismatch Between Commerce Versions 241.0.21 and 243.4.2 Blocks Cross Version Returns
Description:
h3. Issue Overview:

TVS is unable to process a return on version 9712 (running commerceVersion 241.0.21) for a transaction completed on version 9710 (running commerceVersion 243.4.2).

The error appears to stem from a deserialization issue in the logs, where {{java.util.Date}} cannot be parsed. This is likely because version 243 switched from using {{Date}} to {{LocalDateTime}} in requests and responses.

h3. Error Message:

{noformat}Caused by: org.springframework.http.converter.HttpMessageNotReadableException: JSON parse error: Cannot deserialize value of type `java.util.Date` from Object value (token `JsonToken.FIELD_NAME`)
	at org.springframework.http.converter.json.AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.readJavaType(AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java:406)
	at org.springframework.http.converter.json.AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.read(AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java:354)
	at org.springframework.web.client.HttpMessageConverterExtractor.extractData(HttpMessageConverterExtractor.java:103)
	... 35 common frames omitted
Caused by: com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.exc.MismatchedInputException: Cannot deserialize value of type `java.util.Date` from Object value (token `JsonToken.FIELD_NAME`)
 at [Source: (org.springframework.util.StreamUtils$NonClosingInputStream); line: 1, column: 172] (through reference chain: org.jumpmind.pos.sales.service.returns.model.ReturnRequestResponse["originalSaleTransaction"]->org.jumpmind.pos.sales.model.RetailTransModel["createTime"])
	at com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.exc.MismatchedInputException.from(MismatchedInputException.java:59){noformat}



This issue leads to the application perceiving the remote service as unavailable, preventing the store from successfully processing the return.

{noformat}2024-11-19 07:33:43.623 WARN  [9712-001:20241119:1675] [StateManagerThread2(pos:9712-001)] [RemoteOnlyStrategy] Remote service remote_central unavailable. {noformat}

Steps to reproduce:

# Select Gift card from hamburger menu.
# Select Load/Issue.

Summary: Add default values to helm chart
Description:
Ajay Chava @ BBW shared the following feedback about our helm charts:

----

We encountered some issues while upgrading to the newly released Helm chart version 243.5.0. Below are the details of the problems we faced and potential areas of improvement in the chart’s structure:

 

# *Inconsistent or Missing Default Values in values.yaml*

 

In the provided values.yaml, certain keys lack explicit default values. While some fields like repository: "" correctly define defaults, others are either missing or only partially defined. For example, the following keys under pos.loadBalancer require explicit definitions:

 

pos:

  loadBalancer:

    enabled: false # Proper default value

    mode: # Missing default value

    image:

      repository: "" # Proper default value

      pullPolicy: "" # Proper default value

      tag: "" # Proper default value

    imagePullSecrets: [] # Missing default value

    serviceAccount:

      create: # Missing default value

      annotations: {} # Proper default value

      name: "" # Proper default value

 

Impact:

* Missing defaults for keys such as mode, and serviceAccount.create can result in nil pointer errors during rendering.

* Explicitly defined defaults (e.g., repository: "", imagePullSecrets: [], pullPolicy, tag, serviecAccount:name””) prevent these issues, but inconsistent definitions increase the likelihood of runtime errors.

 

*Example of Error:*

The following condition in your template causes issues if serviceAccount.create is not defined:

 

{{- if or .Values.pos.loadBalancer.serviceAccount.create (and (eq "api" (include "statelb.pos.mode" .)) (eq .Values.pos.loadBalancer.serviceAccount.create nil)) -}}

-----------------

# *Logical Issue in loadBalancer.enabled Behavior*

 

When pos.loadBalancer.enabled is set to false, dependent fields such as mode, image, and serviceAccount.create are still evaluated. This leads to unexpected errors even when the load balancer is disabled. For example:

 

Error: nil pointer evaluating interface {}.enabled

 

*Expected Behavior:*

* When enabled: false, the chart should short-circuit and skip the evaluation of other related fields.

* Example of robust logic:

{{- if and .Values.pos.loadBalancer.enabled .Values.pos.loadBalancer.serviceAccount.create }}

 

This ensures dependent fields like {{mode}} and {{serviceAccount.create}} are evaluated only if the load balancer is enabled.

-----------------

# *Suggested Improvements*

 

+*_A. Add Consistent Default Values_*+

To avoid nil pointer errors and improve user experience, ensure all fields in values.yaml have explicit defaults. For example:

pos:

  loadBalancer:

    enabled: false

    mode: "" # Default to an empty string

    image:

      repository: "" # Explicit default

      pullPolicy: Always # Suggested default

      tag: latest # Suggested default

    imagePullSecrets: [] # Explicit default

    serviceAccount:

      create: false # Explicit default

      annotations: {} # Explicit default

      name: "" # Explicit default

 

+*_B. Refactor Template Logic_*+

Update your Helm templates to gracefully handle cases where enabled: false. For example:

{{- if .Values.pos.loadBalancer.enabled }}

apiVersion: v1

kind: Service

metadata:

  name: {{ include "statelb.pos.serviceAccountName" . }}

  labels:

    {{- include "statelb.pos.labels" . | nindent 4 }}

spec:

  {{- with .Values.pos.loadBalancer.service.type }}

  type: {{ . }}

  {{- end }}

  ...

{{- end }}

 

+*_Guard Conditions for Nested Fields_*+

For nested fields like serviceAccount.create, add proper checks to avoid evaluating nil values:

{{- if and (hasKey .Values.pos.loadBalancer "serviceAccount") .Values.pos.loadBalancer.serviceAccount.create }}

apiVersion: v1

kind: ServiceAccount

metadata:

  name: {{ include "statelb.pos.serviceAccountName" . }}

  ...

{{- end }}



We kindly request your assistance in addressing these issues. Adding explicit defaults and improving template logic will ensure smoother upgrades and reduce the need for excessive overrides in user-provided {{values.yaml}} files.

Summary: POS is unable to retrieve the transaction for return if transaction has voided EA items
Description:
Steps to reproduce the issue -

# Login to POS
# Add an in-store item & an EA item to the cart 
# Delete the EA item from the cart 
# Complete the transaction with any form of payment 
# Try to retrieve the transaction for return 
# POS shows “Transaction Not Found“ message

Attached commerce log file from the register has the sale transaction 00474-002:20241217:1600 that has a voided EA item. After completing this transaction, when tried to retrieve it for return, POS shows “Transaction Not Found“ message, see timestamp - 2024-12-19 14:53:07

Seems like the issue is in the {{omitOrderParentTransactionsForShippedItems}} method of {{SearchReturnsTransEndpoint}} class.

In the attached commerce log file from CO, shows this message -

_2024-12-19 22:53:07.213 INFO  [-] [qtp1231197143-1063] [SearchReturnsTransEndpoint] Omitting transaction: [00474-002][20241217][1600] order parent id: EA00J1J8Z8G9GR as it appears all EA items have shipped._

Summary: POS application is unable to lookup the product using UPC number when searched under Item Search Menu when UPC is under 13 digit
Description:
Petco used to append the UPCs under 13 digits with leading 0s and load those in the itm_item_id table. So, even if the actual UPC on the product is 12 or 11 digits or under, Petco used to add another record in the itm_item_id table with 13 digit UPC by appending leading 0s, along with loading the actual under 13 digit UPC. 

Recently Petco updated the METL load process and stopped loading the 13 digit UPCs. So, whatever is sent by upstream system is loaded in the database in itm_item_id table. 

Fo example, if the UPC is {{800443717523}}, Petco used to load both {{800443717523}} & {{0800443717523}} in the itm_item_id table, but recently we made a change to only load the actual {{800443717523}}.

After this change, POS is not able to pull the product using this UPC under Item Search, but it works when the UPC is scanned on the Sale cart.

Looks like the issue is in {{getQueryString}} method of {{RegexProductSearchStrategy}} class. I see there is a logic to pre-process the UPC to append the leading 0 before trying to query the database, application doesn’t do the lookup using the UPC number that was entered which is 12 digit. Earlier we used to have the 13 digit SKU with leading 0 in the DB and it used to work.

The same UPC works when scanned on Sale Cart because, there is a logic in {{FindItemEndpoint}} to lookup the item using both the leading 0 & without leading 0 UPCs. Looks like the same logic needs to be added in the {{RegexProductSearchStrategy}}.

Summary: Giftcards fail to load at POS while it is already loaded per Aurus and SVS
Description:
Giftcards fail to load at POS while it is already loaded per Aurus and SVS

Per Aurus:

Giftcard CLOSE TRANS RETRY logic causes issues with subsequent TransRequest / Response from Aurus and POS behavior seems to be the issue. They need to make a SDK level change which is necessary but a will be a bigger and longer lift from testing and release stand point.

But we also see an opportunity where a CLOSE TRANS Retry logic in the logs which we would like to review why it is happening and look to avoid which would also solve the issue we have. This is where we need your help with.

Attaching logs and what Aurus had to say with this ticket. 

*From Aurus*

Below are the observations and details of the behavior.

 

# The POS sent a CloseTransactionRequest to AESDK at 14:44:55,952. AESDK processed this request and sent an Approval CloseTransactionResponse to the POS at 14:44:59,401.
# 2570 milliseconds after the CloseTransactionResponse was sent to the POS, AESDK cleared the data and reset the variable. This means AESDK was expected to clear the data at approximately 14:45:01,970.
# The POS immediately sent a new TransRequest to AESDK at 14:44:59,555, just 150 milliseconds after the CloseTransactionResponse. AESDK processed this TransRequest with the CCT and Host.
# AESDK received an Approval TransResponse from the CCT and processed it at 14:45:01,958.
# Since the timestamps for the Approval TransResponse received from CCT and the data clearing after the CloseTransactionResponse match, the TransResponse received from the CCT was inadvertently cleared at the AESDK end.
# As a result, AESDK was unable to send the Approval TransResponse to the POS and instead sent a "TIMEOUT" response to the POS after 3 minutes.

_If an instance is terminated while the lock is still held, an instance with the same server ID is allowed to re-acquire the lock. Summary: ops_unit_status table needs business_date added to primary key
Description:
BBW’s transaction numbers roll over after 9,999 , so they are already seeing some registers cycle back to transaction #1. Because the ops_unit_status table does not include business_date, it is sometimes overwriting older records in this table and is not updating the create_time. The ops queries are based on create_time, so this is causing issues with store close.



{noformat} ops-query.yml
 -------------   
    name: activeTillsSinceLatestStoreOpen
    select:
      select distinct t.TILL_ID
      from TillModel t
      join UnitStatusModel u on u.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = t.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID and u.UNIT_ID = t.TILL_ID
    where:
      u.UNIT_TYPE = 'TILL' and
      u.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = ${businessUnitId} and
      u.CREATE_TIME >
        (select max(s.CREATE_TIME)
          from UnitStatusModel s
          where
          s.UNIT_TYPE = 'STORE' and
          s.UNIT_STATUS = 'OPEN' and
          s.UNIT_ID = ${businessUnitId} and
          s.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = ${businessUnitId}){noformat}



{noformat}@TableDef(name = "unit_status",
        primaryKey = {"deviceId", "businessUnitId", "sequenceNumber"}){noformat}

Summary: TPS - Returns not Going to Ayden
Description:
We are having an issue with returns that we need help with please. 

We are noticing that there are returns being made at the point of sale, when the customer is in store all processed as intended - however- the return is never made back to Ayden. When we check the original transaction, the return is referencing, no return PSP is being created. In the database, we can see all the return information. The examples I've seen are typically tied to a BOPIS or order originating online, but there could potentially be others out there. 

 I can attempt to get logs from Logic if needed, but there is no guarantee they have them from these days. The examples I have the SQL ran to where we can see the returns being successful in the database are below:

Summary: Close till - Expected amount increments each time a user closes the tlll without reconciling on the same day
Description:
While a user close the till without reconciling , and reopens the till the same day, it adds up float+amount of cash transaction. When they close the till again , this amount is adding the differential amount again, which is causing the discrepancy.

To reproduce:

# Open store and till
# Ring a cash sale transaction
# Close the till, but choose note to reconcile the till
# Open the till, note the default expected cash amount (it will be the float + the amount of the cash sale)
# Close the till again. Again, choose not to reconcile
# Open the till. The amount expected includes double the amount from the cash transaction.
# This process can be repeated and the expected amount will increment each time

The underlying issue appears to be that the session id doesn’t change unless the till is reconciled.

Summary: Not able to checkout as Guest when customer is not a Shukran member
Description:
The issue is not reproducible locally, but based on shared logs and code analysis:

[^20240120_551_Logs.rar]

When a user clicks "Close" or "Continue as Guest" in the loyalty lookup screen, the system should transition to SaleState and build the sale screen. However, while the system does transition to SalesState, it intermittently enters an unintended loop due to incorrect flag handling.

The issue occurs in the onHandlePrompts() action handler which is called during the sale state transition.

!image-20250203-151739.png|width=1532,height=671,alt="image-20250203-151739.png"!

When promptForLoyaltyCustomer() is called, it checks shouldPromptForLoyalty(), if it is true then it will call LookupCustomer action, instead of proceeding to the sale screen.

!image-20250203-151755.png|width=1533,height=706,alt="image-20250203-151755.png"!

This happens because the *promptedForLoyalty* flag in *shouldPromptForLoyalty()* is not being set to false on onHandlePrompts() action handler when the user clicks close or continue as guest. This results in LookupCustomer being called again, creating the loop.

On local, this issue has not occurred even once. Every time, the flag is set correctly.
If possible, we can try reproducing this in the lab with an actual device.



This issue seems to be from the JMC base side. Need to ensure that PromptedForLoyalty flag is set to false when "Close" or "Continue as Guest" is clicked.

Summary: Qualification Attribute in UserModel.additionalFields Lost After Suspend/Resume, Preventing Employee Discount Promotion from Qualifying
Description:
Currently, on commerceVersion=243.4.3, TVS is experiencing an issue where the employee discount is not applied when the transaction is resumed. The employee discount is correctly qualified and rewarded before suspending the transaction, but fails to reapply after resumption. For reference, see JMC-1323-video.webm to observe the issue.

*Investigation:*

* Upon investigation, I found that TVS is using a custom qualification attribute with {{id == employeeType}}.
* If this attribute has a value of DEFAULT, the employee discount promotion (PromotionId == PERMANENTPROMOS-3-1) is successfully qualified and rewarded.
* While debugging {{AttributesAnalyzer.evaluate()}}, I noticed the following behavior:
** The *employeeType* attribute exists when attaching an employee to the transaction (see EmployeeDiscountBeforeResume.png).
** However, after resuming the transaction, the *employeeType* attribute is missing (see EmployeeDiscountAfterResuming.png).

*Root Cause:*

* I traced this issue back to when attributes are built in RetailManager*.*buildTransactionLevelAttributes().
* When the employee discount is added for TVS, the employeeType attribute is stored in {{UserModel.additionalFields()}}, like so:
{noformat}if (employee != null) {

Summary: TPS Prod Urgent Bug - Invalid Zip Code Error
Description:
This is causing a big headache for our stores currently live. We need to figure out the cause and fix ASAP please.

24/Feb/25 12:49 PM;62d82941751c4f698e03958a;We have not stated definitively that the logging issue is the root cause of all the issues including the coupon. However, depending on your logging configuration, threads could be affected which might not show up on monitoring. The inability of a thread to write to a log can stop processing, but it depends on how logging is implemented and handled in the application. For example:

* If logging is done synchronously (e.g., directly writing to a file or database within the same execution thread), a failure in logging (e.g., file permission issues, disk full, or lock contention) could block the thread and halt processing.
* If the logging function throws an unhandled exception, it could crash the thread or even the entire application.
* If a thread holds a lock (e.g., on a database record or shared resource) and then attempts to log, while another thread holds a logging-related lock and needs the first lock to proceed, a deadlock can occur, halting processing.
* If logging errors are not handled properly, an exception in the logging framework itself could propagate and stop processing.

24/Feb/25 1:35 PM;qm:d8936ec3-5736-46a1-a0a2-e185d8b412c9:c6a093bd-15b6-4fdb-bc28-40e8c802375c;@Mike Logging is very specific to JM and has got nothing to do infrastructure or capacity. So it doesnt matter how your software implements logging, whether its doing it Synch or Async or if there are thread issues. We just have fluent bit pods listening to the EKS node directory usually something like /var/log/containers/*.log 

So here is how it works in a nutshell:
EKS PODS (Including the UPE Pods) write their logs to STDOUT/STDERR, then container runtime captures these streams and then saves to Node File System (/var/log/containers/*.log ) , Fluent Bit Pods  deployed as Daemonsets are listening to changes in this directory at each node and just send  whatever new they see over to AWS S3 and Log Dashboard. 


For further reading you can refer to [https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/logging/#how-nodes-handle-container-logs|https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/logging/#how-nodes-handle-container-logs|smart-link]

Summary: JMC 243.4.3 AUTO_CLOSE of Suspended transactions at the Ops End of Day create Suspended CANCELED transactions whose transaction number is over written by CLOSE_STORE_BANK transaction causing MEDIA RECON issues in Sales Audit
Description:
JMC 243.4.3 AUTO_CLOSE of Suspended transactions at the Ops End of Day create Suspended CANCELED transactions whose transaction number is over written by CLOSE_STORE_BANK transaction causing MEDIA RECON issues in Sales Audi

When there are SUSPENDED transactions that are NOT addressed during the day of the store and when the store HE closes the store for the day, the AUTO_CLOSE suspended tran handling configuration tries to auto retrieve and auto cancel these transactions.

Attached is sample screenshot with list of transactions from QA, where we could recreate the scenario.

In the process a SUSPEND_RETRIEVED and a SUSPEND CANCELED transactions are created, in our case they were 4736 and 4737.

Soon enough, the CLOSE_BANK_STORE transaction comes and over-writes the 4737 SUSPEND CANCELED transaction.

Note: Since it is the same transaction number, Trans publisher sends the first and not the second causing Media Reconciliation errors in sales audit.

Summary: "New Card" Tender for mixed cart containing a special order is not working
Description:
TVS reported the following issue:

When choosing “New Card” to pay for the special order part of a mixed cart, the transaction completes or the insert card portion is skipped.

Steps to reproduce:

# Attach customer to transaction
# Add any cash and carry item
# Add a special order item (ship to home or ship to store)
# Checkout
# On the tender screen choose Card to pay for the cash and carry item
# On the tender screen to pay for the special order choose Card and then New Card. Transaction completes and goes to the receipt selection screen.

Different combinations tested where this bug is present:
Ship to home, ship to store, cash and carry with ADP
Ship to store, cash and carry with ADP
Ship to store, cash and carry

Logic Comments:

* When the  {{New Card}} button is clicked on CardSelection flwo it receives the action CardSelectionComplete with action handler onCardSelectionComplete in TenderCardState.class. 
* The method enters the following condition:
** {{else if (this.currentTenderAmount != null && this.currentTenderAmount.isPositive() && this.currentTenderGroup.getTenderAuthMethodTypeCode().equals(TenderAuthMethodTypeCode.PRE_AUTH))}}` followed by a GetCardDataSuccess action

Summary: Reports | Tills reports are inaccurate after "fast opening" till
Description:
sls-query.yml has lots of queries used in reports that are trying to find the session_id by looking for the most recent “OPEN_TILL” record for the till, like so:


{noformat}        and T.SESSION_ID =
            (select SESSION_ID from TransModel where CREATE_TIME = (
                select MAX(CREATE_TIME) from TransModel where TRANS_TYPE = 'OPEN_TILL' and TRANS_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' and BUSINESS_DATE = ${businessDate} and BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = ${businessUnitId} and TILL_ID = ${tillId})
                and TRANS_TYPE = 'OPEN_TILL' and TRANS_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' and BUSINESS_DATE = ${businessDate} and BUSINESS_UNIT_ID = ${businessUnitId} and TILL_ID = ${tillId}){noformat}


The problem is that the TRANS_TYPE is set to ‘FAST_OPEN_TILL’ if you fast open, so these queries need to be changed to “TRANS_TYPE IN ('OPEN_TILL', ‘FAST_OPEN_TILL')”, or we need to find a better way to get the current session_id.

Summary: JMC flashes password reset successful/unsuccessful screen when changing password via the ChangePasswordActionHandler
Description:

{noformat}+--------------------------------------------------+
| +----------------------------------------------+ |

+--------------------------------------------------+ {noformat}

{noformat}2025-03-17 09:22:26.956 INFO  [9780-001:9999] [StateManagerThread2(pos:9780-001)] [ShowScreenAfterActionLoop] Screen builder order: [org.jumpmind.pos.app.state.sale.salestate.BuildSaleUIMessageScreen] {noformat}

Summary: Need the ability to configure an extended return period (particularly) for the Holiday season when our normal 30 days expands to be transactions between extended date period
Description:
Need the ability to configure an extended return period (particularly) for the Holiday season when our normal 30 days expands to be transactions between extended date period

Ex. 

During the holiday period RCL will have an extended return period so items purchased between Oct. 1 - Dec. 30 will be returnable until Jan. 30.

This means that our ‘normal’ 30 day setting for returns needs to be ignored starting 31 days after Oct. 1 for any transactions from Oct. 1 forward but not for transaction prior to Oct. 1.  

Then the 30 days can kick back in for transactions starting on Dec. 31 (which would then have 30 days to be returned) BUT while still allowing transactions from Oct. 1 to be returned up until Jan. 30.

We had to manually go in and change the config for the returns during this extended period for the 2024/2025 holiday season. 

Is there a configuration that can currently handle this type of exception?  If not is there a way to provide a way before the holiday period in 2025/26 ?

Either thru a different type of config that provides a hierarchy of return dates 30 days except for transactions from Oct 1/YY to Dec. 30/YY so the transaction date dictates if it falls in the 30 days OR the longer period. 

PSQ-1076 exists on our Jira board for this issue.

Summary: Discounts | Manual $ discount should multiply instead of divide by the item quantity
Description:
Currently, when you perform an item discount on an item that has a quantity > 1, the amount entered will be divided by the item’s quantity, and distributed proportionally to each item. If you adjust the quantity, the total discount will stay the exact amount that was entered and the amounts distributed to each item on the line will be adjusted.

The desired behavior is to instead multiply the dollar discount amount by the quantity. For example, if you enter a $10 item discount on an item where quantity = 2, each item should receive a $10 discount, and the total discount amount for the line should be $20. If quantity is adjusted, the discount for each item should remain the same ($10) and the total discount for the line should rise or fall accordingly.

Summary: JMC - mPOS failover to the cloud happens often when the primary server is online and available
Description:
The VS configuration:  primary in store server with cloud as the backup.  It is our understanding that mPOS on iOS will try for 30 seconds to connect to the primary.  If the primary is not available it will fail over to the cloud.  When running against the cloud we have two challenges:

# The mPOS printer in the store is not reachable so physical receipts can’t print
# Any mPOS transaction completed while connected to the cloud does not replicate back to the store and reflect in EJ and store reporting.  The store has no visibility to any completed transactions.  They think they are lost.  Can Symetric be configured to replicate this back down to the store EJ and Flash Sales reporting?

How can we resolve the two issues above and also increase the time before the mPOS fails over to the cloud.  Can we increase it to something like120 seconds or longer?  It is very rare the mPOS should connect to the cloud as the in store server is 99% available unless there is a physical hardware problem.

Suggestions to investigate:

# *Get Pod Events*

{noformat}bash{noformat}

{noformat}kubectl describe pod <pod-name> -n <namespace>{noformat}

Look under the
*Events* section for messages about:

* Liveness/readiness probe failures
* OOM (Out Of Memory) kills
* Node pressure (CPU, memory, disk)

# *Check Pod Logs*

{noformat}bash{noformat}

{noformat}kubectl logs <pod-name> -n <namespace> --previous{noformat}

Use
{{--previous}} to view logs from the *previous container instance* (before the restart). Look for:

* Stack traces
* Error messages
* Exceptions or uncaught errors

# *Look at Container Status*

{noformat}bash{noformat}

{noformat}kubectl get pod <pod-name> -n <namespace> -o json | jq '.status.containerStatuses[]'{noformat}

Or just look in the
{{kubectl describe}} output.
Check:

* {{lastState.terminated.reason}}
* {{lastState.terminated.exitCode}}
* {{lastState.terminated.message}}

This gives hints like:

* {{OOMKilled}} (memory exceeded)
* {{Error}} with a non-zero exit code
* {{CrashLoopBackOff}} for repeated crashes

# *Check Resource Usage*


If you have metrics tools installed (e.g., Prometheus, Metrics Server):

{noformat}bash{noformat}

{noformat}kubectl top pod <pod-name> -n <namespace>{noformat}

Look for:

* High memory or CPU usage
* Spikes or sustained consumption

# 


*Audit Probes*
Check the pod's YAML for liveness/readiness probe configurations:

{noformat}bash{noformat}

{noformat}kubectl get pod <pod-name> -n <namespace> -o yaml{noformat}

Look at:

{noformat}yaml{noformat}

{noformat}livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /health
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  timeoutSeconds: 2{noformat}

If they're too aggressive or misconfigured, they might be killing healthy containers.

Example Diagnosis
If you saw something like:

{noformat}plaintext{noformat}

{noformat}Reason: OOMKilled
Exit Code: 137{noformat}

That means the pod ran out of memory, and you’d probably need to:

* Increase the memory limit
* Optimize memory usage in the container app

# Power off the Receipt printer (wait until all lights have turned off). 

# Power the Receipt Printer back on. You should hear the scanner make some beeping noises and in a few minutes a small piece of paper will print out. Wait until the small piece of paper printer before moving to step 3. 

# Close out of the Jumpmind application - so the iPad is displaying the iPad's home screen with all applications installed. 

# Use the four-barcode scan sheet attached and scan each barcode in order - with a slight pause in between. After each barcode some beeping noises should happen. 

# Open the Jumpmind application and login to the "sell" function. 

# Tap the purple barcode in the upper left corner to bring up the camera of the iPad. 



# Once the camera is open - attempt scanning an item with the Zebra gun style barcode scanner. 

# If the scanning is successful, hit the purple barcode button again to close the camera and attempt scanning with the Zebra gun style scanner one more time. If it scans - you are good to go!

Summary: TVS - Order Creation Behavior Clarification
Description:
h3. Business Requirement

For order creation, TVS wants the following

* If a *buddy store* has inventory, allow the item to be added to a *BISPIS* (Buy In Store, Pick up In Store) order.
* If a *Distribution Center (DC)* has inventory, allow the item to be added to a *DELIVERY* order.

----

h3. Current Application Behavior

Currently, the application logic follows this pattern:

* If {{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}} returns a response where {{availabilityTypeCode == InventoryServiceAvailabilityTypeCode.UNAVAILABLE}}, the associate is *not able to add the item to either a DELIVERY or BISPIS order*.

----

h3. Endpoint Breakdown

h4. {{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}}

* *TVS implementation*: Calls the service that fetches inventory availability from the Distribution Center (DC).

h4. {{GetBuddyStoreEndpoint}}

* *TVS implementation*: Queries store inventories within range of a given ZIP code.

----

h3. Scenario Causing Issues

When the *Distribution Center has zero inventory*, the response from {{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}} has:

{noformat}availabilityTypeCode == InventoryServiceAvailabilityTypeCode.UNAVAILABLE{noformat}

Due to this response, the *BISPIS option is also disabled*, even if buddy stores *do* have inventory. This happens because of logic within the {{ProductDetailsState}} base code:

{noformat}protected boolean isButtonEnabled(ButtonModel button) {
    final List<String> possibleButtonValues = List.of(
        CommonActionsConstants.ADD_DELIVERY_ORDER_ITEM_ACTION,
        CommonActionsConstants.ADD_PICKUP_ORDER_ITEM_ACTION,
        CommonActionsConstants.ADD_ITEM_TO_UNIVERSAL_CART,
        CommonActionsConstants.ADD_RETURN_ITEM_ACTION
    );

    return button.isEnabled()
        && item != null
        && (possibleButtonValues.stream().anyMatch(t -> t.equals(button.getButtonValue())) ?
            InventoryServiceAvailabilityTypeCode.AVAILABLE.equals(itemOrderAvailability) :
            InventoryServiceAvailabilityTypeCode.AVAILABLE.equals(itemBusinessUnitAvailability)
            || InventoryServiceAvailabilityTypeCode.OFFLINE.equals(itemBusinessUnitAvailability))
        && (!TrainingModeHelper.isTrainingMode(clientContext)
            || button.isEnableInTrainingMode());
}{noformat}

----

h3. Problem Summary

* The system relies solely on {{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}} to determine both *DELIVERY and BISPIS* eligibility.
* Even though {{GetBuddyStoreEndpoint}} successfully runs and may return available inventory, its result is not considered if the DC has no inventory.
* *As a result*, the application disables the option to add the item to a BISPIS order incorrectly.

----

h3. Proposal

When implementing {{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}} for TVS, the assumption was that it would only control *DELIVERY* order eligibility.
To resolve this inconsistency, I am proposing the following:

{quote}Separate the logic determining eligibility for DELIVERY and BISPIS orders:

* Let {{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}} dictate DELIVERY eligibility or create a new endpoint specific to determining DELIVERY order eligibility
* Let {{GetBuddyStoreEndpoint}} independently determine BISPIS eligibility.{quote}

This approach will ensure that buddy store inventory is correctly considered even if DC inventory is unavailable.

Summary: Performance Review – Excessive Endpoint Calls During Order Creation
Description:
TVS has raised concerns regarding *too many network calls* being made during the order creation flow, particularly around the *product details screen* and order type selection.

Below is a breakdown of the number of times key endpoints are called at various points in the flow:

----

h4. On Entering the Product Details Screen

||Endpoint||Number of Executions||
|{{GetBuddyStoreEndpoint}}|2|
|{{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}}|1|

----

h4. Creating a Delivery Order

||Endpoint||Number of Executions||
|{{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}}|1|
|{{ReserveItemEndpoint}}|1|

----

h4. Creating a BISPIS Order

||Endpoint||Number of Executions||
|{{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}}|1|
|{{GetBuddyStoreEndpoint}}|1|
|{{ReserveItemEndpoint}}|1|

----

h3. Concerns



* It’s unclear why {{GetBuddyStoreEndpoint}} is called *twice* upon entering the product details screen. This may be redundant.
* {{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}} is executed *multiple times* throughout the order flow. While necessary in some cases, it might be redundant—especially since the {{ReserveItemEndpoint}} is also invoked later, providing overlapping availability data.

This repetitive behavior may be contributing to unnecessary latency and backend load.

----

h3. Recommendation

TVS would like to optimize the order creation flow by reducing unnecessary or duplicate calls. Suggested next steps:

* *Investigate* why {{GetBuddyStoreEndpoint}} is being called twice on product load.
* *Assess* whether repeated calls to {{GetItemOrderAvailabilityEndpoint}} can be consolidated or cached, especially when {{ReserveItemEndpoint}} follows shortly after.

Summary: Request To Have Text Files for Coupon Download
Description:
Update to ticket description:
This is an enhancement request.

Currently the button “Download Codes“ downloads the coupon file which is a csv of COUPON, LOYALTY values.

What the business needs is another button which could do a download of ONLY the coupon codes as a text file and NOT a comma separated file with other necessary values for a promotion coupon file.

Business share that list of COUPONs only with vendors and with other internal teams.

This is needed only from a DOWNLOAD stand point as we understand for the Promo create you need that in a specific format.



----

When coupon requests have one million or more single-use codes, the file is too large for Excel to open.

For the Download Codes option in JumpMind Promote, we are asking for that to be a text file instead of an Excel file. This also means that the “Spark – Single Use Promo Code Import” would also need to be a text file instead of an Excel file.

With the current Excel file option, updating and re-saving a new file takes more time; it also leaves more room for error and potentially sending wrong/incorrect codes to the business owner.

Summary: Does JMC support repack during order fulfillment
Description:
We had a call with TVS’s OMS team to discuss the APIs that JMC requires for the order fulfillment flow. During the discussion, a question was raised about handling repacking in the case of a damaged item. The scenario is as follows:

* A store receives a *Ship to Store* order, which appears in the *PICK* swim lane.
* The store picks the two items in the order.
* The store packs the items and places the bin on a shelf, awaiting customer pickup.
* One of the items is damaged before pickup and cannot be given to the customer.

*Question:*
Is there a way for the associate to go back into the system, repack a replacement item, and also notify downstream and inventory systems that one item was broken and a new one has been pulled from the shelf?

Summary: EOD | Duplicate sequence numbers can occur when cancelling suspended transactions
Description:
We saw an issue at a production BBW store where the remote (business-unit) call to initiateStoreClosing() timed out while it was busy cancelling suspended transactions, causing it to fail over to local and use some duplicate sequence numbers for the remaining suspended transaction cancelations. 

To address this in the short term, I suggested increasing the http timeout for this remote call specifically. 

!image-20250505-170943.png|width=1015,height=778,alt="image-20250505-170943.png"!

We need to come up with a more reliable way of doing this.



----

Log files and analysis:

!image-20250505-171214.png|width=100%,alt="image-20250505-171214.png"!

* At 18:53:59, we made a remote call to the business unit for initiateStoreClosing(). This is the method that cancels suspended transactions. The business unit began working through the suspends and cancelling them.
* At 18:54:19, the fixed register timed out waiting for a response and failed over to the local initiateStoreClosing(). By this point, the business unit had processed all but two of the suspended transactions.
* The fixed register’s execution of initiateStoreClosing() cancelled the remaining two suspends, then set the ctx_sequence value to 3693, overwriting to higher value that was written by the business unit and causing our issue.

[^commerce-businessunit-2025-04-06.1.log]

Summary: EOD | Fast Close cash tender amounts should be set to last open amount
Description:
When fast closing a register that has a till, the open_session_amount, close_session_amount, and counted_session_amount should be set to the open_session_amount from when the till was opened that day. The reason for this is that Fast Close is assuming that since you never opened the drawer, we don’t need to do a physical count - the amount of money in the drawer will be what you started with. 

To reproduce:

# set openpos.ops.till.fastOpenCloseEnabled=true
# Open the store, device, and till. Enter $200  when prompted for starting bank/float
# Ring a sale transaction, tendering with credit card
# Close the till, observe that the open_session_amount, close_session_amount, and counted_session_amount are all $0.00, but should be $200

!image-20250505-200126.png|width=96.54676258992806%,alt="image-20250505-200126.png"!



----

Proposed fix:

{noformat}    public void onFastCloseTill() {
        transMgmtClient.orphanInProgressSaleSession();
        TenderType cash = TenderType
                .builder()
                .tenderTypeCode(TenderTypeCode.CASH)
                .tenderCurrency(appContext.getIsoCurrencyCode())
                .build();
        opsClient.closeTill(tillId, true);
        opsClient.reconcileTill(tillId,
                List.of(
                        TenderCountDetails
                                .builder()
                                .countedTenderAmount(Optional.ofNullable(opsClient.getExpectedTenderAmountTotalInTill(tillId, cash))
                                        .map(Money::getAmount)
                                        .orElse(BigDecimal.ZERO))
                                .acceptCountedAmount(true)
                                .tenderType(cash)
                                .typeCode(RepositoryTypeCode.EXTERNAL_BANK)
                                .tenderUnitCountRequired(true)
                                .acceptCountedQuantity(true)
                                .build()),
                false,
                false);
        actionHelper.doAction("FastCloseDevice");
    }{noformat}

Note that I set the typeCode to {{RepositoryTypeCode.EXTERNAL_BANK}} for my POC, but you should set appropriately based on openpos.ops.storeBankEnabled

Summary: Tender | Improve card tender flow when pre-swipe is enabled
Description:
When openpos.tender.preSwipe is enabled, entering tenderOptionsState will initiate a card swipe on the PED. If the user presses the “card” tender option, we will tear down the card swipe request, then build it again. The ask here is to improve this flow to use the active card swipe request instead of cancelling the old one and calling getCardData again. 

To reproduce:

# set openpos.tender.preSwipe = true
# Start a new sale transaction, do not swipe a card yet.
# Press checkout
# Observe the the PED lights up for a card swipe
# Press the card tender button
# {color:#ff5630}Observe the delay as the swipe is cancelled and then requested again{color}

Summary: BarcodeConfig settings from the yaml file are not being honored.
Description:
When setting the {{barcodeConfig}} settings in the yaml file, they are not fully honored in the Default Barcode Manager.

For example, if you set {{businessUnitId: 6}} and you only have a business unit id of length 5, it will not prepend a 0.  For {{workstationId: 2}}, if your workstation id is a length of 3, it will just add all 3, and will not truncate it.

Steps to reproduce:
Set the following in the application-func.yml [file:|file:￼The]
 The business unit length is 4 and the workstation id is 3.

{noformat}  device:
    deviceIdFormat:
      format: '%s-%s'
      elements:
        - name: businessUnitId
          startIndex: 0
          endIndex: 4
        - name: workstationId
          startIndex: 5
          endIndex: 8

receipt:
  dateFormat: 'MMddyy'
  barcodeTypeEnabled: false
  barcodeConfig:
    sales:
      elements:
        businessUnitId: 6
        workstationId: 2
        sequenceNumber: 6
        businessDate: 6{noformat}
